Variants.Content: How a valley views outsiders often says more about its character than official etiquette. Outsiders must pass through narrow mountain passes, so they are often regarded as potential threats; valley people are confident in their wealth, but also wary of being involved in external disputes; trade routes, marriage alliances, and wars will continue forces this judgment to change.
